configurations.hypothesis: Day 6 dense retrieval with the starter's small context budget establishes the baseline.
Exact lexical terms may recover evidence missed by dense ranking at the same context budget.
RRF combines lexical specificity and dense semantic similarity without summing raw scores.
A larger context and another model-directed search can recover complete evidence; newest results can replace stale context.
